summary: Public MetaMCP validation passes all seven servers and seven safe calls, but repeated internal sessions drop Kubernetes; one stale unmapped row remains and OAuth metadata is not ChatGPT-ready.
validation: ArgoCD homelab application is Synced/Healthy and MetaMCP runs 2.4.22 at an immutable digest.
Public authenticated initialize and tools/list returned 145 tools across all seven required prefixes.
Public safe calls passed: Prometheus health, Loki datasource health, Tempo attributes, GitHub get_me, GitHub Actions list, ArgoCD applications, and Kubernetes namespaces.
Repeated in-cluster tools/list waited 60 seconds and returned 131 tools without Kubernetes; logs report no Kubernetes session.
OAuth protected-resource and authorization-server metadata return 200 and advertise PKCE S256 and DCR.
OAuth issuer strings differ by trailing slash; iss support and resource/audience propagation are absent or unproven against current MetaMCP behavior.
The supported management UI/API could not be used because no browser session is available; no direct SQL deletion was performed.
blockers: Long-lived flock wraps the persistent Kubernetes MCP process and causes repeated child-session timeout; replace it with one-shot prefetch locking.
Stale unmapped observability-endpoint still targets the retired VPN hostname and causes startup ENOTFOUND noise.
ChatGPT OAuth readiness is incomplete: exact issuer match, iss response handling, resource echo/audience validation, and callback allowlisting are not proven.
No browser session is available to remove the stale row through the supported MetaMCP management UI/API or complete a real ChatGPT OAuth consent flow.
next_action: Advance through the required approval gate to code, patch Kubernetes startup locking via GitOps, then rerun repeated aggregate and safe-call validation; retain OAuth/UI items as explicit residuals if user interaction remains unavailable.

issues.title: Persistent Kubernetes child is held behind flock
issues.details: PR 447 locks the long-lived npx process, so a second session waits for MetaMCP timeout and loses Kubernetes from aggregate tools/list.

issues.title: Unmapped retired observability endpoint remains
issues.details: The old VPN hostname remains as an unmapped database row and produces startup DNS failures; supported UI/API cleanup needs an authenticated browser session.

issues.title: OAuth metadata is not fully ChatGPT-compatible
issues.details: Current upstream behavior omits issuer-response support and resource propagation, while protected-resource and authorization metadata disagree on the issuer trailing slash.
